title: Cap Chaos level
description: One level, fully data-driven (GDD §6). Structural checks live here; semantic checks (floating bottles, hidden-on-ground, colour balance, solvability, lock/link targets) are LevelValidator V2–V7.

id.description: Must equal the file name without extension.

colors.description: Palette subset used by this level. Hex values live in DesignTokens, never here.

layers.description: layers[0] is the GROUND. Each layer is `rows` strings of `cols` chars; string 0 is the BACK row, the last string is the FRONT row (nearest the player).

items.description: '.' empty · UPPERCASE visible bottle · lowercase hidden (rainbow) bottle, revealed on reaching the ground.

lanes.description: Conveyor queues left→right. Element [0] of each lane is the tappable front tray. A lowercase code is a HIDDEN tray (R17): no colour until it reaches the front.

locks.description: Locked trays (R18): not tappable until `turns` trays have flown to the slots while it stands at the front of its lane. V7: the tray exists, is locked once and is not linked.

links.description: Linked tray pairs (R19): they fly to the slots together (2 free slots needed) or not at all. V7: two neighbours in one lane, or the same position of two neighbouring lanes; a tray is in at most one link.

solution.description: One winning tap sequence (lane indices). Written by Tools/LevelTool; V6 replays it as the solvability proof.

colorCode.description: R pink-red · O orange · B blue · G green · P purple · Y yellow · C cyan · N brown

trayCode.description: A colour code; lowercase = hidden tray.

trayRef.description: [lane, tray] — tray is the index in lanes[lane] as authored.
